title: A Border for the Deadline
author: Mara Zhou
blurb: Kestrel Reyes, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, works cases no one wants attributed. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
